content: BOINC-family volunteer computing Folding@home-adjacent, Einstein@Home validates redundant results via application-defined floating-point tolerance, not bit-exact hash match: Einstein@Home accepts if relative difference in a scored value is below a fixed threshold e.g. 0.12, frequency checked to double precision; on disagreement a third redundant instance runs 2-of-3 quorum. Closest real-world analog to XNODE-01 eventual on-chain-style consensus check: tolerance-based comparison of scalar/derived metrics, not raw-buffer hashing.
